requirements.evidence: Most of the task is absent or broken: resources/views/livewire/entity/queues.blade.php:13 says '<!-- Modals would be included here, omitted for brevity -->' so create/detail/rename/toggle/access modals are not rendered; no Members tab change exists at all (app/Livewire/Entity/Members.php not in diff); app/Livewire/Entity/Serve.php:7,10 has a duplicate import that is a PHP fatal; routes/web.php:1-15 deletes every pre-existing route. The job 'cannot work'.

conventions.evidence: Livewire policy ignored: no #[Validate] on Queues.php:20/25, no #[Locked] on Queues.php:19-27 or Serve.php:17-20, no $this->authorize anywhere (Queues.php:29-32, 67-87, 172-191); routes use Route::get(...Component::class) and a string gate (routes/web.php:9-12) instead of the project's Route::livewire; logic and hardcoded strings live in Blade (serve.blade.php:5-32); no tests and no docs/CHANGELOG update.

security.evidence: No component-level authorization on any action (Queues.php:67-87 create, 115-131 rename, 144-155 toggleActive, 172-191 grant/revoke; Serve.php:23-28 mount, 60-76 callNext) and no #[Locked] on server context: Queues.php:19 `public Entity $entity`, Serve.php:20 `public ?int $lastCalledTicketId`. Client-controlled `mode` is fed to CallMode::from at Serve.php:68 without validation. Impact is partly mitigated because ids are scoped via `$this->entity->queues()->findOrFail()` (Queues.php:39,102,117,146; Serve.php:44,67) and domain actions authorize internally.

tests.evidence: No test files at all in change.diff; no happy-path, validation, unauthorized-call or tamper tests for the new Livewire components, despite the convention that everything implemented ships with a test.

simplicity.evidence: Domain writes do go through CreateQueue/UpdateQueue/SetQueueAccess/CallNextTicket (Queues.php:70,120,149,177,188; Serve.php:68) rather than re-implementing rules, but there is duplication and dead code: `use App\Models\EntityMembership;` and `use App\Models\UserRole;` (Queues.php:10,12) unused, `ValidationException` unused in Serve.php:12, and the same Gate check is hand-rolled twice (Serve.php:34 and 48).

readability.evidence: Barely readable: `getAccessGrantsProperty` actually returns all entity memberships (Queues.php:49) with a return type split across lines (Queues.php:42-43); error strings are hardcoded and untranslated (Queues.php:158,185,196); serve.blade.php has hardcoded English labels (serve.blade.php:5,7,17,20-22,32); stray `?>` closers in every added PHP file (ui.php:29, queues.blade.php:15, routes/web.php:15).

scope.evidence: routes/web.php:1-15 destroys unrelated functionality: all auth, onboarding, dashboard, members, settings, password-reset and email-verification routes are deleted, which is far outside the task.

issues.explanation: The route file is rewritten from scratch, deleting login, register, logout, onboarding, dashboard, members, settings, switcher, password reset and email verification routes and keeping only queues/serve, so the application is unusable.
`use App\Enums\TicketStatus;` is declared twice, which is a PHP fatal 'Cannot use ... because the name is already in use' and prevents the component from loading.

The queues view states the modals are 'omitted for brevity'; the create form, detail, rename, toggle-confirmation and access modals required by the task are all absent, so most of the page does nothing.
The members-page tab requirement is not implemented at all: no `activeTab`, no `setActiveTab`, no tab bar and no invite-only-on-invites-tab rendering.

Mount and every public action skip server-side authorization; the task requires mount to authorize `create`/`view` and the conventions require `$this->authorize(...)` inside each action, so the components rely entirely on the domain actions.

Server-only context is not `#[Locked]`; in particular `lastCalledTicketId` is client-writable although the task explicitly says it must not be, and `$entity` can be swapped to another tenant in the component payload.

`mode` is public and unvalidated, so a tampered value makes `CallMode::from($this->mode)` throw an uncaught ValueError (500) instead of being rejected; it needs an `in:any,priority_only,normal_only` rule.
No rate limiting is applied to successful `callNext()` calls, contrary to the task's 10/min per user and entity requirement.

All labels are hardcoded English ('Serve for', 'Select Queue', 'Mode', 'Any', 'Waiting List') instead of `lang/*/ui.php`, and the required `ui.serve_empty` empty state is never rendered when the ticket list is empty.
The `nav_serve` link is placed inside `@can('manageSettings', $currentEntity)`, so ordinary employees cannot reach the serve page even though it is meant for any member.

Routes are registered with `Route::get('queues', EntityQueues::class)` rather than the project's `Route::livewire(...)`/`Route::get` invokable pattern, and `can:create,queue,entity` is not a valid queue policy argument, so the routes are unlikely to dispatch.
`name` and `renameName` have no `#[Validate]` attributes and no `$this->validate()` call, deviating from the project's mandated Livewire validation pattern.
The change ships zero tests, violating the test-first rule and leaving unauthorized-call and tamper behaviour unverified.

The language files are created as new files containing only the newly added keys, so pre-existing keys still referenced by the layout (e.g. `ui.nav_settings`) are missing; and `queues_toggle_message` (`'Are you sure you want to :queue?'`) passes the queue name where an action is expected.

`accessGrants` returns every entity membership with its queue accesses, not the grants for the selected queue as required, and it is exposed through v2-style `getXProperty` magic rather than a `#[Computed]` property, so the view contract is wrong.
`openQueue()` only stores the raw id and never resolves or checks the queue against the entity, and the view never reads `viewingQueueId`, so the detail modal can never appear.

`dispatchBrowserEvent()` and `getXProperty` computed properties are Livewire 2 APIs removed/changed in Livewire 3/4, so modal events and computed view data will not work under the project's Livewire version.
`getCallableQueues()` is a public internal helper, making it a client-callable endpoint; conventions require internal helpers to be `protected`/`private`.
Inactive queues display the label `ui.queues_deactivate` ('Deactivate') as their status instead of showing active/inactive status text.
Domain failures are surfaced with hardcoded English strings rather than translated `ui.*` messages, and the `\Throwable` catch in the serve waiting-list getter (Serve.php:45) swallows real errors.
Added pure-PHP files end with a closing `?>` tag and Blade files open with a PHP block, against Laravel/PHP file style.
Unused imports (`EntityMembership`, `UserRole`, `ValidationException`) and an unused `$queue` assignment in `create()` add dead code.

review.summary: The change adds two Livewire components, two Blade views, two lang files, nav links and routes, but the queues page is mostly a stub with its modals explicitly omitted and the serve page hardcodes English text. It also rewrites routes/web.php to delete every pre-existing route, ships a duplicate import that is a PHP fatal, leaves the Members tabs unimplemented, and omits all tests, so it cannot be approved.
